info.title: FetchX API
info.description:
FetchX gets any public URL and returns its data. POST /v1/fetch does the work; the other endpoints read results, download files, list, delete and report credits.

Two status layers: the HTTP code says whether FetchX accepted the call; the `status` field says what happened to the fetch. A fetch that ran and failed is HTTP 200 with `status: failed`. A pending fetch is HTTP 202. A 4xx means the request itself was wrong, nothing was sent to the site and nothing was charged.

Billing: a request is charged only when it succeeds, at the price of the step that got the data. Failed, uncertain and refused requests cost nothing.

servers.description: Your API host, shown in the console and returned by the Connect flow as api_base_url.

tags.name: Fetch
tags.description: Get URLs and read the results.

post.description: Gets a URL and returns its data. With only `url`, FetchX climbs from the cheapest route (HTTP direct, datacenter, residential with fresh IPs on a 429, then a browser) until the site gives its real answer, starting at the step that worked for this site before. Only the step that worked is charged. GET and HEAD may use up to `max_attempts` attempts; any other method gets exactly one attempt and never a browser.

post.description: FetchX POSTs the finished result (without the body) to webhook_url. Verify `X-FetchX-Signature: sha256=<hex>`, an HMAC-SHA256 with the project's webhook secret over `<X-FetchX-Timestamp>.<raw body>`. Delivery is tried 3 times.

ApiKey.description: A project API key (fxk_...), made in the console or by the Connect flow. Each operation lists the scope it needs in x-scope: fetch:write, fetch:read or usage:read.

url.description: The page, API or file to get. Public http or https only: private, local and metadata addresses are refused, checked after DNS and on every redirect.

method.description: Only GET and HEAD escalate. Other methods get one attempt, never a browser, and are never retried.

headers.description: Headers for the site, cookies and Authorization included (stored encrypted, never logged). Up to 64 headers and 16 KB. Host, hop-by-hop, Forwarded and X-Forwarded-* are refused.

body.description: A text request body, up to 1 MB. Only with POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE.

body_base64.description: A binary request body in base64, instead of body.

render.description: auto tries HTTP first and moves to a browser when HTTP is blocked or the page is an empty JavaScript shell; always starts in a browser; never stays on HTTP.

wait_for.description: In a browser, wait for a CSS selector or a fixed time. Implies a browser.

country.description: The exit country for proxy routes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Defaults to the country that worked for this site before, else US.

route.description: One fixed route; turns auto mode off: one attempt, with a precise error.

country.description: Required for datacenter and residential; null for direct.

render.description: true uses a browser on this route.

formats.description: Extra outputs. screenshot needs a browser.

include_body.description: Return the body. Set false when only formats are needed.

max_attempts.description: The most attempts that may reach the site. Steps refused before anything is sent do not count.

fix_headers.description: Replace automation User-Agents (curl, python-requests…) with a browser one and add a missing Accept and Accept-Language.

max_credits.description: The most this request may cost. Steps that would cost more are skipped.

timeout_ms.description: Total time for all attempts. A captcha solve can take up to a minute, so the default leaves room for one; a synchronous call still answers 202 after 60 seconds if the request is not finished.

async.description: true answers 202 at once; false waits up to 60 seconds, then answers 202.

webhook_url.description: A public https URL that receives the result when the request finishes.

idempotency_key.description: The same key with the same body returns the same result and is charged once. Generated when absent.

tags.description: Your labels, to filter the list.

data.description: What the site answered: on success the real answer, on failure the last response. Null only when nothing reached the site.

max.description: The most this request could have cost (null for unmetered projects).

attempts.description: One entry per step tried, in order. Providers are never named.

skipped.description: Steps that were not tried, and why.

rendered.description: True when a browser produced the result.

content_expired.description: True after 7 days or DELETE: everything below is gone.

cookies.description: Cookies the site set, for multi-step flows.

body.description: The body: utf-8 text, or base64 for binary. Left out when include_body is false or when it is too large to inline (see body_url).

body_url.description: Where to download a body too large to inline.

json.description: formats: json, the body parsed as JSON (null when it is not JSON).

screenshot.description: formats: screenshot, base64 JPEG. Also at /v1/fetch/{id}/screenshot.

rotation.description: A fresh residential IP for the same step.

result.description: not_admitted means nothing reached the site on this step (for example the provider refused the host); it does not count as an attempt.

code.description: The underlying error, when result is not_admitted or failed.

captcha.description: Captchas met on this step, as type:outcome.

reason.description: For example excluded_by_provider_rule, over_max_credits or cooling.
